    String classification on the quotient-category algebra skeleton #

    The quotient-category algebra is built from covariant representables, whereas the manuscript's literal right string modules are contravariant functors on the quotient category. The finite-category projective-generator equivalence therefore first pulls an algebra-module skeleton back to covariant quotient- category modules. Pointwise coefficient duality then transports that skeleton to the contravariant variance classified by literal strings.

    Consequently each original algebra-skeleton object is represented by the reverse coefficient dual of one canonically selected literal string. This file keeps that duality explicit; it does not identify the two variances.
